narration.text: Why 7.7 billion people depend on air-made fertilizer.
The Haber process pulls nitrogen from the air.
Air is about 78% nitrogen, but it barely reacts.
Each pass converts only about 15% into ammonia.
Recycling the gases eventually reaches 97% conversion.
It uses 3 to 5% of the world's natural gas.
Without it, today's harvests couldn't feed today's population.
So much of the food on your plate began as air.
